title: Primality Testing in Python: From Trial Division to Sieve
snippet: Trial division only needs to check divisors up to the square root of n, since any factor larger than the square root would pair with one smaller than it.

title: Euclidean algorithms (Basic and Extended) - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: For small to moderate numbers, trial division up to sqrt(n), skipping even numbers after checking 2, is a simple and efficient primality test.
